take: The Islanders announced they recalled D Kashawn Aitcheson and F Pierre Engvall from Hamilton (AHL) and placed forwards Matias Maccelli and Cal Ritchie on injured reserve, retroactive to Oct. 17. Maccelli had 6 points in 8 games, and the Islanders controlled 56% of the quality chances (expected goals) with him on the ice at five-on-five, about 6 points better than without him. In the 3 games he has missed, Kyle MacLean has taken his spot beside Cizikas and Holmstrom, Simon Holmstrom has moved onto the first power-play unit (19:59 a night, up from 15:43), and Kyle Palmieri is up to 17:39 from 15:38.
